document.retrieval_note: A plain request got HTTP 403 from the carrier's content delivery network. With a browser User-Agent header the address redirects to the same path without .pdf and returns the PDF.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw. The SBC is printed pages 1 to 6 of 6, which are PDF pages 1 to 6; PDF pages 7 to 12 are the carrier's nondiscrimination and language notices. The -layout output interleaves the columns of the service chart on pages 2 and 3, so its rows were read from the -raw output. The chart's columns are "Network Provider" and "Out-of-Network Provider"; page 1 says "All copayment and coinsurance costs shown in this chart are after your deductible has been met, if a deductible applies."
